name: @mls/mcp-tools
description: Meridian Launch Systems MCP tool server (L8): the five ops/sec/cost tools exposed over Streamable HTTP for the custom Microsoft Copilot Studio agent to attach as tools. No LLM lives here.
//dependencies: Cloud-path packages (@azure/identity, @azure/monitor-opentelemetry, mssql) are declared here but imported LAZILY: nothing loads them on the local backend, so `MLS_TOOL_BACKENDS=local` pays no start-up cost for them and a laptop with no tenant still boots. @opentelemetry/api is the one static import — it is dependency-free and no-ops until a provider is registered.
